title: Labels for the Store

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: In winter it's dark early, and I can never find anything in the store!

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: Would you write a label for each box? Listen to each word, and put its sounds in order.

steps.speaker: hannah
steps.prompt: Listen to the word. Which sounds do you hear? Put each letter in its place.

older.prompt: Listen to the word. Which sounds do you hear, first to last? Find each letter in the box.

feedback.wrong: Listen again: {word}. That sound goes somewhere else.
feedback.all_good: Every box is labelled. Now I'll find things even in the dark!

outro.speaker: hannah
outro.text: Logs, pots and jam, all labelled! Thank you. You've worked so hard this week.

journal_line: I wrote labels for the boxes in Mrs. Hannah's store.
